item.title: The Importance of Infant, Toddler, & Preschooler Mental Health
item.description: September 26, 2023 Many young children are struggling with mental health issues that have become more noticeable and more urgent as time goes on. Behaviors range from: inability to focus, crying, aggression, screaming, and hitting. Also, food refusal, nightmares, sleep issues, & self-harming behaviors can be evident.
